train_predictor: train a transformer predictor on searchless chess data and return trained parameters
build_transformer_predictor: build a transformer predictor model from a transformer configuration object
create_optimizer_chain: create an optax optimizer chain with gradient clipping and adam for parameter updates
checkpoint_training_state: checkpoint training state including params, ema params, optimizer state, and data iterator
restore_checkpoint: restore a previous training checkpoint to resume training from a saved step
